problems.title: Trace

parts.prompt: Window start (left) after processing the whole string?

problems.solution: Answer 3. At the final 'b' (index 7), its last occurrence is 6, so left = 7.

problems.title: The abba trap
problems.statement: "abba" with the rule left = last[c] + 1 applied without checking last[c] ≥ left.

parts.prompt: Left after the final 'a' (index 3) with the buggy rule?
Answer reported by the buggy code?

hints: At index 2, left = 2. At index 3, last['a'] = 0.
problems.solution: The buggy rule moves left back to 1, giving window "bba" of length 3, which repeats b. Correct answer 2.

problems.title: Monotonicity

options: Sum exactly k with negative numbers

hints: Does growing a window only make it worse?
problems.solution: All except the one with negatives: there, growing can fix an invalid window, so shrinking decisions aren't safe.

problems.title: Exactly k distinct
problems.statement: Count subarrays with exactly k distinct values.
hints: atMost counts are each one sliding window.

problems.title: Why the deque is O(n)

parts.prompt: is pushed and popped how many times at most?

problems.solution: Once each: O(n) total for the deque operations.

problems.title: Minimum window by hand

parts.prompt: Length of the first valid window found (ending at the first C)?

problems.solution: The first valid window is "ADOBEC" (6); shrinking and sliding eventually finds "BANC" (4).

problems.title: Fixed-size windows
problems.statement: Maximum average of any subarray of length k = 4 in [1, 12, −5, −6, 50, 3].
hints: Add the new element, subtract the one k back.
